feeding_claim.verbatim: Today, we operate on over 400 acres of land producing corn silage and hay for our livestock feed.

resold_note: Also sells soap from Bubbly Duck Soap Company.
notes: Site calls the beef grass-fed and pasture-raised and says animals get as much pasture as possible, but the about page says the farm grows corn silage and hay for livestock feed, so the diet looks mixed; Verifier to check. Lamb is from Karen's Lambs, run by a family member. Farm market open Tuesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday; hours vary by season. Homepage social feed mentions markets in Kent, Black Rock, Greenwich, Newtown and Blueback; not confirmed on a farm page. No phone, bulk shares, delivery or shipping stated for meat. Also sells honey, maple syrup, fiber goods and hay.
